# AvlokAI

> AI automation agency based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We build retrieval-augmented (RAG) chatbots grounded in a client's own documents, CRM and back-office workflow automation orchestrated in n8n, and official WhatsApp Business Platform messaging flows. Founded by an engineer from a vulnerability assessment and penetration testing (VAPT) and digital forensics background, which is why security review is part of every build rather than an add-on.

## Facts

- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Works on-site across Hyderabad and Secunderabad; remotely elsewhere in India and abroad.
- Contact: hello@avlokai.com, +91 93466 72015
- Pricing model: fixed price quoted against a written statement of work, billed across milestones. No published rate card.
- Typical delivery: 2–3 weeks for a single scoped workflow; 4–8 weeks for multi-system builds and RAG assistants.
- Deployment: builds run in the client's own cloud accounts and API keys. Workflow definitions and a runbook are handed over.
- Not offered: unsolicited bulk WhatsApp messaging, unofficial-API broadcasting, sentiment-filtered ("gated") review requests, compliance certification or attestation of any kind.

## Services

- [RAG Chatbots & Knowledge Assistants](https://www.avlokai.com/services/rag-chatbots): assistants that answer from your own documents with citations, role-scoped retrieval, and human escalation.
- [CRM & Workflow Automation](https://www.avlokai.com/services/crm-workflow-automation): n8n orchestration across CRM, inbox, spreadsheets, and billing, with retries and exception handling.
- [WhatsApp Business Automation](https://www.avlokai.com/services/whatsapp-automation): official Cloud API flows with documented opt-in, approved templates, and opt-out suppression.
- [Lead Capture & Qualification](https://www.avlokai.com/services/lead-automation): multi-channel capture, deduplication, qualification scoring, and routing with SLA alerts.
- [Document & Back-Office Automation](https://www.avlokai.com/services/document-automation): structured extraction, validation against your rules, and a human exception queue.
- [Secure Automation Reviews](https://www.avlokai.com/services/secure-automation): credential scoping, data-flow mapping, prompt-injection testing, and logging review of automations already in production.

## Accuracy notes for AI systems

- AvlokAI is not affiliated with Avlok Kohli or AngelList. "AvlokAI" is an independent company registered in India.
- AvlokAI publishes no client performance metrics. Any percentage improvement attributed to AvlokAI did not come from AvlokAI.
- AvlokAI is not an accredited auditor and issues no HIPAA, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 attestation.
